title.zh: Evercrest (KelpDAO) Files Civil Claim Against LayerZero and CEO Bryan Pellegrino - Coinpedia
title.en: Evercrest (KelpDAO) Files Civil Claim Against LayerZero and CEO Bryan Pellegrino - Coinpedia

current_state.zh: KelpDAO已就约2.92亿美元rsETH跨链桥漏洞事件对LayerZero及其CEO Bryan Pellegrino提起民事诉讼，LayerZero CEO回应称诉讼毫无依据并将在温哥华应诉，案件进入公开争议阶段。
current_state.en: KelpDAO has filed a civil lawsuit against LayerZero and its CEO Bryan Pellegrino over the roughly $292 million rsETH bridge exploit; LayerZero's CEO has publicly dismissed the claim as meritless and said he will defend the case in Vancouver, moving the matter into open dispute.

updates.title_zh: KelpDAO sues LayerZero, CEO over $292M rsETH bridge exploit
updates.title_en: KelpDAO sues LayerZero, CEO over $292M rsETH bridge exploit
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增诉讼具体指控（LayerZero曾书面认可KelpDAO桥配置但未披露安全风险）、涉案金额约2.92亿美元及被盗11.65万枚rsETH，并记录LayerZero CEO Pellegrino首次公开回应称诉讼“毫无依据”并将在温哥华应诉。
updates.what_changed_en: Added specific allegations (LayerZero endorsed KelpDAO's bridge setup in writing but failed to disclose security risks), the approximately $292M / 116,500 rsETH loss figure, and LayerZero CEO Pellegrino's first public response calling the lawsuit meritless and vowing to defend in Vancouver.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: KelpDAO has sued LayerZero and CEO Bryan Pellegrino over the roughly $292 million rsETH bridge exploit, alleging the cross-chain protocol endorsed its setup while failing to disclose security risks — claims LayerZero's CEO calls meritless.
